evidence.reason: This is a proposal to widen the post-switch check, not an implementation error in the intended behavior. The method's own docstring at lines 983-984 defines the contract: "The three facts a switch must not change: queue bytes, runtime pointer and rollback permission." runtime_pointer_check implements exactly two of those (pointer at 1008, bytes/existence at 1013), and the refusal message is explicitly about "unverified bytes". Execute mode is not one of the stated facts, so requiring a mode comparison before restart adds a new protection requirement rather than repairing existing intended behavior. The supplied evidence also does not show that measure_cq_bin captures a mode field for the pre-deploy measurement, so the recommendation would require adding measurement, not just comparing an existing value. A symlink/pointer switch likewise does not itself alter the target file's mode; an external chmod is drift outside the switch-verification check. No current-contract or deploy-runbook text supplied imposes a mode check on this path.
